title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I gotta write about JaCoby. How do you view his season? I’m writing that he did enough to be the starter coming into next season, but how does Cameron fit? Chance to make good impression in Sept., compete for spot in spring, but likely competing with Demeritte in right, and still needs to earn everyday spot with performance? No quotes
Everything you mention here is good, September call up not 💯 just yet
Any thoughts on putting that Hardy trade out there now? Figure it could show that you guys got screwed in a trade that would’ve helped. Doubt you can trade him now, probably non-tender, but your call
